name: agent-browser
description: XGEN Side — a cross-platform, skill-routed AI browser

scripts.version: npm run version:sync && git add cli/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:native: npm run version:sync && cargo build --release --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml && node scripts/copy-native.js
scripts.dev:xgen-side: pnpm run build:xgen-core && node scripts/xgen-side.mjs dev
scripts.build:xgen-side: pnpm run build:xgen-core && node scripts/xgen-side.mjs build
scripts.package:xgen-side:dir: pnpm run build:xgen-side && pnpm --dir apps/desktop package:dir
scripts.package:xgen-side:mac: pnpm run build:xgen-side && pnpm --dir apps/desktop package:mac
scripts.package:xgen-side:win: pnpm run build:xgen-side && pnpm --dir apps/desktop package:win
scripts.test:xgen-side: pnpm run test:xgen-core && node scripts/xgen-side.mjs test
